title: Interactive Household Switcher, Member Management & Invite Code Sharing
acceptance_criteria: Add backend endpoint POST /api/v1/households/join with inviteCode parameter that validates code and adds current user as a Member to the household.
Add backend endpoint GET /api/v1/households/{id}/members returning the list of members, their roles, and joined dates.
Remove hardcoded 'Поділ, вул. Спаська' and obsolete 'TASK-07' badge from App.tsx header.
Add interactive HouseholdSelector in navbar querying live GET /api/v1/households and displaying active household name, role, and member count.
Allow switching active household, persisting selection in app context/session, and dynamically refreshing inventory, recipes, and shopping list for the selected household.
Add HouseholdModal with invite code display, 1-click 'Скопіювати код запрошення' clipboard button, and 'Приєднатися до сім'ї за кодом' input.
